title: Dual-Hypergraph Indexing: Bridging Knowledge Islands for Multi-Hop Reasoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.28108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While hypergraph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively captures higher-order multi-entity correlations, existing paradigms treat extracted hyperedges as isolated factual assertions. This structural fragmentation engenders rigid "knowledge islands" that bottleneck multi-hop causal inference, temporal tracking, and narrative synthesis. To systematically address these challenges, we introduce Dual-Hypergraph Indexing (DHI), a hierarchical representation framework that elevates discrete facts into structured analytical insights. DHI couples a foundational entity-relation factual hypergraph ($H_K$) with an elevated deep-insight hypergraph ($H_D$) via a dual-pathway aggregation algorithm. Specifically, DHI employs: (1) importance-driven hub aggregation via 5-metric topological profiling and adaptive thresholding to capture spatial semantic clusters; and (2) temporal chunk-chain progressive aggregation via sliding-window greedy

translated_title: 双超图索引：桥接知识孤岛以实现检索增强生成中的多跳推理
translated_abstract: 尽管基于超图的检索增强生成（RAG）能够有效捕获高阶多实体关联，但现有范式将提取的超边视为孤立的事实断言。这种结构性碎片化催生了僵化的“知识孤岛”，成为多跳因果推理、时间追踪和叙事合成的瓶颈。为系统性地应对这些挑战，我们提出了双超图索引（Dual-Hypergraph Indexing, DHI），这是一种将离散事实提升为结构化分析洞见的分层表示框架。DHI 通过双通路聚合算法，将基础的实体-关系事实超图（$H_K$）与高层的深层洞见超图（$H_D$）相耦合。具体而言，DHI 采用：（1）基于重要性的枢纽聚合，通过五指标拓扑画像与自适应阈值来捕获空间语义聚类；（2）时间块链渐进聚合，通过滑动窗口贪婪[摘要原文在此处截断]
tldr: 提出双超图索引（DHI）框架，通过将实体-关系事实超图与深层洞见超图相耦合的双通路聚合算法，打破超图RAG中的“知识孤岛”，从而提升多跳因果推理、时间追踪与叙事合成能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Dual-Hypergraph Indexing (DHI), a hierarchical framework that couples a factual entity-relation hypergraph with a deep-insight hypergraph via dual-pathway aggregation, bridging "knowledge islands" to enable multi-hop reasoning in hypergraph-based RAG.
